ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-11-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor and an Adult.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Clifford Y. Wang, Esq. appeared with petitioner Cui Yi Zhen, who was present as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Pei Zhao Zhen.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Clifford Y. Wang was placed under oath and served as Cantonese speaking interpreter for petitioner.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Kelly Cuiyi Zhen.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Jacky Peizhao Zhen.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
